import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv', columns=['amount', 'is_fraud', 'transaction_type', 'hour_of_day'])

# Split dataset into genuine and fraudulent transactions
genuine = data[data['is_fraud'] == 0]
fraudulent = data[data['is_fraud'] == 1]

# Create a bar chart for transaction types
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', data=data)
plt.title('Transaction Types')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Transaction Type')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_transaction_types.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a histogram for transaction amounts
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.histplot(data['amount'], bins=50)
plt.title('Transaction Amounts')
plt.xlabel('Amount ($)')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_amount_histogram.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a scatter plot of transaction amounts by hour of day for genuine transactions
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='amount', y='hour_of_day', data=genuine)
plt.title('Genuine Transaction Amounts by Hour of Day')
plt.xlabel('Amount ($)')
plt.ylabel('Hour of Day')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_genuine_amounts_hour.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a box plot of transaction amounts by hour of day for genuine and fraudulent transactions
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='hour_of_day', y='amount', data=genuine, color='blue', label='Genuine')
sns.boxplot(x='hour_of_day', y='amount', data=fraudulent, color='red', label='Fraudulent')
plt.title('Transaction Amounts by Hour of Day for Genuine and Fraudulent Transactions')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Amount ($)')
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_amounts_hour_genuine_fraudulent.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
